name: DataVolt NEOM Oxagon AI data center campus (AI factory)
notes: NEOM and DataVolt signed a ~$5 billion agreement to design and develop a net-zero AI factory campus at Oxagon (NEOM, Tabuk Region). Program/campus-level capacity ~1.5 GW powered by wind and solar; first phase expected operational by 2028 per NEOM/Baxtel. AGBI (Aug 2026) reports NEOM to start constructing the Oxagon AI data centre within months. Per SA methodology, 1.5 GW is campus-program capacity, not a single-facility rating; no CST registration or Balady/NCEC permit evidence found yet.

name: TONOMUS.Neom Telecommunications Center data center (Oxagon)
notes: DCD reports the July 2023 inauguration of an 18,000 sqm digital communications facility in the Oxagon industrial area of NEOM containing a high-capacity, highly efficient data center for 5G, satellite and fiber connectivity plus secure private cloud services projected to serve up to 60 locations and ~1,800 structures. Vendors include Huawei, STC Solutions, XFusion, Fortinet, NEC. Baxtel directory (C) lists ~12 MW for Tonomus/NEOM city as the largest Tabuk-market facility; official capacity not published.

name: NEOM hyperscale data center - ZeroPointDC (NEOM-EzdiTek JV) with Oracle OCI first tenant
notes: NEOM announced an approx. $500M joint venture (51% NEOM / 49% EzdiTek, later branded ZeroPointDC) to develop and operate hyperscale data centers in NEOM, reportedly on the Oxagon floating industrial district. NEOM Tech & Digital Holding signed Oracle as first tenant, with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure hosted at the hyperscale data center; Oracle region status was 'coming soon' as of May 2023. Directory sources (C) cite up to 500 MW Tier IV program capacity. No construction/CST/permit evidence found - keep at planned per SA methodology.

name: stc Haql Cable Landing Station (Uptime-certified)
notes: Uptime Institute Tier Achievement listing names 'Haql Cable Landing Station' (Tabuk, Saudi Arabia) with client Saudi Telecom Company (stc) - A-grade facility existence/certification per SA methodology. center3 (stc's digital infrastructure arm) operates stc's cable landing stations in Saudi Arabia; the Haql site is a Red Sea coast cable landing/edge facility near NEOM. Capacity and Tier level not shown on the public page.
